textRuns.value: Scope: hourly profiles are means across the analysis window in analysis/dfw_passenger_flow.py (signature analysis #6). Checkpoint Hour is TSA's full national checkpoint feed, filtered to DFW above; CBP Wait Hour is DFW-only by data construction. BTS-proxy international arrivals are a schedule-based estimate (BTS T-100 segment is out of scope -- ADR 0012), not a direct CBP measurement, so the cross-check at right is a shape comparison, not a reconciliation to the decimal.
